messages:
maya: Quick sync: webinar next Wed on inference economics. Need: one-page bench note, two hero soundbites for landing, and a lead-routing spec for SDRs. Can we lock today?
raj: I'll run hosted vs dedicated for chat (2k) and embeddings (batch 64). p50/p95 + cost per 1k tokens. ETA 3pm.
tori: I'll capture warm vs cold tail and note cache priming.
sam: Proposed routing tags: webinar_infer=true, region=NA/EU/APAC, intent=hot/warm/cold. Routing: hot->AE immediate, warm->SDR sequence, cold->drip. Can we fire via webhook?
jordan: Yes, can add hidden inputs and POST to /webhooks/lead-route. Send final field names.
maya: Hero lines: A) "Reduces unit cost while controlling latency" B) "Same serving across hosted → dedicated → private" — use "up to" for percent claims and link to appendix.
raj: Uploaded bench CSV + p95 chart and annotated assumptions (quant, batching).
launchbot: Reminder: update landing copy + webhook by 09:00 tomorrow.
maya: I'll draft the battlecard and tag SDRs for a 10am handoff. If silence, we ship tomorrow morning. :rocket:
